sentence: This project tests how well deep learning models detect malicious software by changing malware code so the models fail to spot it.
This project studies how plants make signals from lipids in chloroplasts and use them to respond to stress.
This project builds a wireless ear device with a chip that uses artificial intelligence to spot seizures from brain signals.
This project studies how transcription factors control growth genes to set the final size of leaves and flowers in Arabidopsis thaliana.
This project expands an open-source database that shows when species diverged from common ancestors, using timetrees.
This project holds a conference where researchers share work on making solid materials and studying their structures and properties.
This project builds tools to measure, detect and control the effects of cyberattacks on continuous manufacturing systems.
This project builds a computing cluster that joins three kinds of accelerator technology to study how future computers can be designed and programmed.
This project builds software that lets many institutions study genomic data together without sharing the data itself.
This project tests whether tropical oceans were extremely warm long ago and how climate change affected the cycling of calcium and carbon.
This project studies how living things with slender, flexible bodies move and control those movements.
This project uses non-invasive sensing and artificial intelligence to collect and analyze data about alcohol and drug abuse securely.
This project gets a white-laser confocal microscope that makes faster, more accurate images and separates signal from noise.
This project studies how quantum computers can learn from data and how to train quantum learning models efficiently using Fourier analysis.
This project studies how marine sediment microbes oxidize minerals, especially sulfur, and how this helps them fix carbon.
This project studies how people use and manage cryptographic keys in the real world to find designs that are useful, easy to use and secure.
This project builds an artificial intelligence tool that outlines brain tumors and stroke lesions in medical images.
